description: Write to the person who opened a support request. The text becomes a comment the requester can read on their page and is emailed to them — unlike add_comment, which is always internal and never reaches the requester. Write it to the customer, in their language (get_support_request says which). Requires full write access to the support project. Answers with the comment id and whether the letter went ('emailed'; 'emailError' when it failed — the reply is kept either way).

body.description: What to tell the requester. Markdown is kept as written.

key.description: Issue key of the request, e.g. 'SUPPORT-12'.

name: reply_to_requester
